title: Which vehicle passed most often in one hour?
description: A list of fifty vehicles that passed a house between nine and ten in the morning is turned into a frequency table with tally marks. The greatest count shows the most used means of transport, and the counts are checked against fifty.
teaching_notes: One idea: tally each entry of a long list, count the tallies into a table, and check that the counts add up to the number of entries. Watch for students who skip an entry or count one twice.

video_script.why: The child turns a long list into a table, the first of the three displays, and reads the exact counts and the greatest one.
video_script.substitution: The list of vehicles that passed a house is turned into a table.
video_script.anchor: a list of fifty vehicles that passed in front of a house from nine to ten in the morning
video_script.payoff_line: Bikes were used the most, with thirteen of the fifty

final_answer.value: Bike 13, Car 6, Bicycle 8, Auto rickshaw 8, Scooter 9, Bus 4, Bullock cart 2; most used: Bike
final_answer.spoken: bike thirteen, car six, bicycle eight, auto rickshaw eight, scooter nine, bus four and bullock cart two; the bike is used the most

maths_rules: the list has 50 entries of 7 kinds of transport
counts: bike 13, car 6, bicycle 8, auto rickshaw 8, scooter 9, bus 4, bullock cart 2
greatest count is 13, so the bike is used the most
to collect the data: list each vehicle as it passes, then tally and count
video_script.design: The long list of the book is sorted into a two-column table with tally marks. The counts are added at the end to match the fifty entries.
